title: Human, Pet Wellness Brands Win 2026 Edition of Makers Mindset x The Equity Studio Grant
summary: The five health and wellness brands have each won $10,000 in equity-free funding as part of the grant for emerging female founders in beauty, health and wellness.

extraction.key_fact: 여성 창업자를 위한 지원금 프로그램에서 건강과 웰니스 브랜드 다섯 곳이 지분 희석 없는 자금을 받았다.
